result.rationale: Primary sources support Wren House remaining the current legal owner through the review date. T-Mobile announced a 50/50 joint venture transaction for i3 Broadband, but the available research through 2026-08-19 did not establish legal closing; therefore T-Mobile is recorded only as a pending incoming owner and the operating platform remains unchanged.

identityResolution.summary: i3 Broadband is the operating fiber platform. Acquired businesses, networks and regulated subsidiaries (including Big River operations) remain beneath the platform rather than being listed separately.

operatingResolution.summary: Keep all owned fiber networks, markets, regulated operating companies and acquired broadband assets beneath the i3 Broadband platform; do not elevate networks or subsidiaries into separate parent companies.

acquisitionExitCheck.summary: Confirmed prior Wren House entry in 2020. Confirmed 2023 expansion through the Big River transaction. No completed Wren House exit or completed T-Mobile ownership transfer was established through 2026-08-19.

milestones.event: Wren House acquired control of i3 Broadband.
i3 Broadband completed acquisition of Big River following regulatory process.
T-Mobile announced planned 50/50 fiber joint venture involving i3 Broadband.
No legal closing located before review cutoff; Wren House remains current legal owner.

evidence.label: T-Mobile transaction announcement
evidence.purpose: Announced 50/50 joint venture and pending transaction

evidence.label: FCC Big River transfer notice
evidence.purpose: Documents i3 Broadband ownership chain and Wren House control during Big River acquisition

beforeAfterChanges.before: Existing record showed Wren House-backed i3 Broadband with pending T-Mobile transaction.
beforeAfterChanges.after: No ownership change. Wren House remains active legal owner; T-Mobile retained only as SIGNED_PENDING_INCOMING for a 50% joint-venture interest pending legal closing.

unresolvedQuestions: Public sources reviewed through 2026-08-19 did not establish legal closing of the announced 2026 joint venture.
Public evidence does not disclose the specific Wren House fund, vehicle or economic stake to record.

confidenceNormalization.basis: The accepted response expressed an overall confidence band with a disclosure-gap qualifier; the staged summary preserves that band in its deterministic qualifier and the research decision is unchanged.
